title: A hurricane is forecast to hit the property
summary: Secure the property, confirm coverage and contacts, back up records, and plan the recovery before landfall.

situation.trigger: A named storm's forecast track includes the property's area.

outlineSteps: Check the forecast track against the property's flood exposure
Confirm policies, deductibles and claim contacts
Photograph the property before the storm
Back up leases, records and contact lists off site
Secure loose items, roofs, openings and drains
Line up generators, pumps and contractors for after the storm
Tell tenants the plan and how to reach the owner
Shut down building systems as the property's plan calls for
Inspect the property once it is safe to return
Open a claim if there is damage
Report status to the lender and investors and record what was done
